status.note: Each entry carries its own authorityStatus. B0_CANDIDATE entries become usable only through the SSCTR disposition recorded for this exact catalog hash; anything not approved there is LATER_GATE. This file never overrides PROGRAM_POLICY_R6.json, the R7-A contracts or the frozen runtime.

envelopeApprovals.dispositions: all ten R6 boundaries APPROVE_WITH_CONDITIONS at the policy hash; every condition of those records applies to the entries that cite them

familiarPathApprovals.note: Exact bounded familiar-task reuse; no new-family calibration or physiological equivalence.

authorityStatus.APPROVED_ENVELOPE: Explicit representation of an R6-POLICY-5 boundary approved at the policy hash; all its conditions apply. Adds no dose.
authorityStatus.APPROVED_FAMILIAR_PATH: Exact bounded R2 familiar-task approval; usable only with its required inputs.
authorityStatus.APPROVED_PRODUCT_DECISION: Structure decided in the PDR (no dose).
authorityStatus.B0_REPRESENTATION: Descriptive metadata or representation without dose effect (anatomy, laterality, equipment, units).
authorityStatus.B0_CANDIDATE: New B0 content with prescriptive impact; usable only after an SSCTR approval recorded for this catalog hash.
authorityStatus.LATER_GATE: Not in the V1 repertoire now; named fallback; needs its own envelope review and scope decision.

ruleBasis.EVIDENCE: Rests on reviewed scientific evidence (approved envelope or SSCTR record).
ruleBasis.PRODUCT_POLICY: Rests on a Founder/product decision (PDR) or a reviewed product boundary.
ruleBasis.IMPLEMENTATION_CHOICE: Operational choice inside an envelope; reversible; never a physiological law.

compositionClass.NONE: No running load (walk, rest by design)
compositionClass.KEY: Protected run (R6 KEY_RUN families: threshold, event-specific, race touch, long, race)

loadConvention.TOTAL: Barbell: whole external load including the bar.
loadConvention.PER_HAND: Two implements: the value is the mass of each.
loadConvention.SINGLE_IMPLEMENT: One dumbbell or kettlebell held by one or both hands: the value is its mass.
loadConvention.MACHINE_STACK: Stack or plate setting of one machine; never comparable across machines.
loadConvention.BODYWEIGHT: No external load value; reps and reserve only.
loadConvention.BAND_TENSION: Band resistance is an athlete-reported ordinal level, never kilograms.
loadConvention.ASSISTED_BODYWEIGHT: Bodyweight with band assistance; assistance is an ordinal level, never kilograms.

laterality.BILATERAL: Both sides together; one set is one set.
laterality.UNILATERAL: One side at a time; reps logged per side, a set counts once per side, sides never summed into bilateral volume.

levels.definition: A training purpose with its own eligibility, boundaries, progression dimension, composition class and safety boundary.

A structural template of a family: ordered typed parameter slots and their admissible domain (a policy ladder or range). Strength: a session template with ordered slots; an exercise configuration is the exercise + implement + load convention.
Concrete values bound to a configuration for one planned session, each with unit, provenance (policy path or ladder index), prescribed/estimated/executed distinction and missingness.
examples: 4 x 5 min work / 2 min recovery, warm-up 10, cool-down 5, cue THRESHOLD_CONTROLLED

levels.definition: Per athlete x family or exercise configuration x dimension: mode, ladder index or reference load/sets, ceilings, gate history and executed-evidence counters. Written only by factual evidence through the R7-A state model; a prescription never writes it.
examples: goblet-squat FROM_LOG adopted 16 kg SINGLE_IMPLEMENT, sets 3, regainCap null

rules: A new number is a dose inside an existing configuration domain, never a new family or configuration.
Every dose value carries its policy path or ladder index; values absent from the athlete's evidence stay unknown, never defaulted from a population mean.

Canonical units are minutes, seconds, kilograms and repetitions; pace/speed, pounds and locale formats are display representations (DR-103, DR-114). A pound value is converted at the boundary under policy:operational.strength.loadUnits.
Planned, estimated and executed values are distinct classes; derived totals never become a requirement to run extra distance.

intensityMethods.rule: Default method for every run family: talk test and perceived-effort cue. The first exposure to each intensity family is a calibration that records observed pace and response.

A pace target is admissible only when it is the athlete's current familiar target for the exact same task, with comparable conditions, provenance and known tolerance. It is not LT2, CS, MLSS or race pace, and never transfers to another family or distance.
Never: an aspirational time goal or easy pace defines no training pace (policy principles; R6 request section 4).

RESTART mode: offset policy:operational.run.restart.longRunOffsetMinutes, capped by the single-run ceiling

negative: WALK_JOG, RESTART and RETURN modes; establishment and the first two established weeks
More than one quality session per week

templateRules.authority: R6 TYPES/SLOTS at the freeze (APPROVED_ENVELOPE runtime binding) unchanged; goalContext alternatives, subpattern constraints and the CALF alternation are B0-C05.
templateRules.slotRoleIsContextualRole: The role of a selected configuration is the role of the slot it fills in this program context (DR-134); a configuration may fill a slot only if its admissibleRoles include that role.
templateRules.selection: Within a slot, filter by available equipment, skill admissibility (classification.skillAdmissibility) and admissible role; a configuration is used at most once per session (R6 exclude-used). Emphasis preferences reorder and choose among admissible alternatives; they never invent competence or add a dose beyond the goal dose (R6; CQ-18 representation).
selectionOrder: purpose matches the goal context (RUNNING_SUPPORT, HYPERTROPHY, STRENGTH_DEVELOPMENT, GENERAL)
slot default subpattern (patternDefaultSubpattern), unless a goalContext alternation asks for the other
external loading before bodyweight or band
templateRules.selectionOrderBasis: IMPLEMENTATION_CHOICE for determinism; it changes no dose and no admissibility. It extends the R6 candidatesFor order (familiar, external loading, skill, id) so that the larger catalog keeps sensible defaults.
templateRules.fitting: Fitted to the chosen time per session: accessories go before main lifts lose sets; maxExercises policy:operational.strength.maxExercises; minimum session policy:operational.strength.minimumSessionMinutes.
templateRules.doses: Goal doses policy:operational.strength.goalDoses; rest and preparation by role policy:operational.strength.restSeconds and policy:operational.strength.preparationMinutes; the R6 strength candidate rules at the freeze set row dose by contextual role. B0 adds no dose.

skillLadders.rule: A progression is never automatic: it is offered at a block boundary review, with the athlete's agency, after the earlier configuration's final exposures in the block were ADVANCE or EARNED; the new configuration starts with effort-guided establishment, no load is transferred and its earlier set count returns per policy:operational.strength.setsAfterReestablishment. HIGH skill stays familiarity-gated unless reached through this ladder. A regression along the same chain is a valid reason-based substitution (SKILL_MISMATCH).

closeVariationRule.definition: Directed relation A -> B: same pattern and subpattern; at least one shared primary muscle; skill(B) <= skill(A); lower, axial and eccentric classes of B within one step of A; both admit the role in question. It identifies admissible replacements; effective permission still depends on rotation eligibility, equipment, phase and agency (DR-134). A configuration serving MAIN cannot evade its stability rule by being called a close variation.

EVERY_2_WEEKS.ACCESSORY: TWO_WEEK_ELIGIBLE when an admissible alternative exists, else BLOCK_BOUNDARY_ELIGIBLE

rotation.admissibleAlternative: Same slot pattern with the same subpattern or a subpattern of the same rotation group (subpatternGroups), or a listed goalContext alternative pattern; at least one shared primary muscle; lower, axial and eccentric classes within one step of the current configuration; equipment available on that date; skill admissible; admissibleRoles include the slot role; the week's arrangement cost on both axes not worse than with the current configuration (composition.ranking); not the configuration used in the previous rotation of that slot when another alternative exists.
rotation.deferredPhasesRule: policy:operational.rotation.deferInPhases plus the R6-ROTATION condition for ESTABLISHMENT: effective eligibility is REASON_ONLY.
rotation.dose: policy:operational.rotation.notes: a rotated exercise starts with effort-guided establishment, no load transferred, no progression step in its first exposure; rotated back after more than policy:operational.return.moderateMaxDays days it re-establishes with its last logged load as a ceiling; sets return per policy:operational.strength.setsAfterReestablishment.
rotation.permittedNotMandatory: An eligible change is an opportunity; keeping the configuration is always valid.
rotation.mainBlockBoundaryChange: B0-C06 extends R6's 'main lifts stay': at a block boundary a MAIN configuration may change only with a recorded reason (DELIBERATE_BLOCK_TRANSITION with its purpose, SKILL_PROGRESSION through skillLadders with agency, EQUIPMENT_CHANGE, ATHLETE_PREFERENCE); default is keep; never in deferred phases; the new MAIN starts with establishment and no load transfer.

substitution.precedence: A justified reason-based substitution overrides the nominal cadence, MAIN retention and a FIXED preference, never coverage, safety/policy, clinical limits or agency (DR-134).

reasons.rule: Dated window or permanent change; same pattern first, variant family second; established originals return after the window (SUBSTITUTION_ENGINE_R6).
Athlete reports the configuration cannot be performed with stable technique: the previous configuration on its skill ladder.

First the clinical screen: pain, injury, illness or a functional limitation routes CLINICAL_HUMAN_REQUIRED for the dependent scope; ambiguous is ASK. Only a confirmed nonclinical dislike or discomfort without pain substitutes a same-pattern alternative, disclosed. No rehabilitation rule.

reasons.authority: B0-C11 (SIS section 5 DR-112 paragraph; SSCTR OB-2 Q1 condition 3)
reasons.rule: Choose a lower lower-body-demand or lower-eccentric alternative of the same pattern only when the arrangement cannot otherwise protect the key run; disclosed.
No plateau threshold is defined in V1 (R7-B whole-program progression).

substitution.ranking: Familiar first; then a close variation of the original; then the same subpattern; then the same pattern; a bodyweight-for-load swap is disclosed as a different stimulus. An unfamiliar substitute starts with establishment (at most policy:operational.establishment.effortGuidedLoad sets at its reserve), no load conversion, no progression in its first exposure.
substitution.noAlternative: A pattern with no admissible configuration is disclosed with options, never silently omitted (B0-C09).

pullCoverage.rule: The PULL disclosure is computed from the rows actually selected: it appears only when no MAIN-admissible pull configuration fits the equipment and skill on that date. Then the slot takes the best ACCESSORY-admissible pull (role ACCESSORY) and the program carries PULL_LIMITED_FOR_EQUIPMENT with options ['Add a band or a bar', 'Accept limited pull work']. Never 'PULL unavailable' while a pull row is programmed (JUDGE-CQ-R6-12).

noviceDensity.rule: Strength class NONE: in ESTABLISHMENT and until the first block boundary, at most two full templates (TPL.FULL_A, TPL.FULL_B) per week whatever the number of chosen strength days; further chosen strength days carry TPL.CORE at practice/accessory dose, explained as lower-demand by design (DR-112: shorter, easier sessions inside approved recipes first), and the program carries the non-blocking negotiation STRENGTH_DAYS_ABOVE_CURRENT_PRACTICE with options ['Keep the days with lighter sessions', 'Choose fewer strength days']. Reassessed at the block boundary from executed evidence.

configurationFields.lower: Lower-body demand class at goal dose (R6 interference input; dose-adjusted by the R6 rules).
configurationFields.axial: Ordinal spinal-loading prior at the reviewed dose range.
configurationFields.ecc: Ordinal eccentric/lengthened-loading prior: muscle-damage potential when unaccustomed.
configurationFields.sec: Secondary muscles (listed, never summed into systemic load).
configurationFields.roles: Admissible contextual roles (not a universal role).
configurationFields.r6Delta: Declared difference from the R6 runtime representation, for R7-B.

strength.demandSemantics: Demand classes are ordinal priors for comparing alternatives and placing sessions; they are dose-, athlete- and evidence-dependent, never a fatigue measurement, a recovery timer or an additive score (STIL sections 5 and 7; SIS section 5). recoveryCostClass(session) = HIGH if any row is HEAVY lower after the R6 dose adjustment or axial HIGH at goal dose; MODERATE if any row is MODERATE lower, axial MODERATE or eccentric HIGH; otherwise LOW.
strength.muscleCounting: IMPLEMENTATION_CHOICE pending G02: weekly working sets are counted once per primary muscle; secondary muscles are listed, not counted; unilateral sets count once per side; warm-up and preparation sets never count (STIL section 2; SIL-I5).

r6Delta.conv: R6 derives PER_HAND from DUMBBELLS; one implement is held: SINGLE_IMPLEMENT (JUDGE-CQ-R6-07).
R6 derives PER_HAND from KETTLEBELL; one implement: SINGLE_IMPLEMENT.
R6 derives PER_HAND; one kettlebell: SINGLE_IMPLEMENT.
R6 derives PER_HAND; one dumbbell across the hips: SINGLE_IMPLEMENT.

configurations.name: Wall-supported tibialis raise
configurations.note: Local capacity only; no injury-prevention or transfer claim.

r6Delta.conv: R6 derives PER_HAND; one dumbbell per side: SINGLE_IMPLEMENT, logged per side.
R6 derives convention BODYWEIGHT and prescribes ESTABLISH rows in KG for band loading; band tension is an ordinal level: BAND_TENSION, progression by reps, never kilograms.

r6Delta.loading: R6 derives loading EXTERNAL from PULL_UP_BAR; a pull-up is bodyweight: BODYWEIGHT (added load is not in V1).

configurations.name: Prone Y-T-W raise
configurations.note: Low-load scapular work; when it is the only pull option the program discloses PULL_LIMITED_FOR_EQUIPMENT.

r6Delta.lat: R6 marks it bilateral; it is held one side at a time: UNILATERAL, logged per side.

r6Delta.conv: R6 derives convention BODYWEIGHT for band loading: BAND_TENSION.
r6Delta.lat: R6 marks it bilateral; it is resisted one side at a time: UNILATERAL, logged per side.

sessionClasses.run: RUN.family compositionClass: KEY for RUN.THRESHOLD, RUN.EVENT_SPECIFIC, RUN.RACE_TOUCH, RUN.LONG, RUN.RACE, RUN.FAMILIAR_REPEATED_BOUTS; EASY for RUN.EASY (all purposes), RUN.WALK_JOG and strides; NONE for RUN.WALK.
sessionClasses.strengthLower: Max lower-body demand of the session rows after the R6 dose adjustment: a HEAVY configuration with fewer than policy:operational.hybrid.heavyLowerMinimumSets sets counts MODERATE; a MODERATE one with fewer than 2 sets counts LIGHT; CALF rows count at most LIGHT (src/r6-balanced.mjs lowerDemand at the freeze).
sessionClasses.strengthKey: A strength session is key when it is heavy and contains a MAIN SQUAT or HINGE row.

interferenceRelations.after: KEY run other than the race

interferenceRelations.before: a session containing a HIGH-eccentric lower configuration or a lower configuration in its first or re-establishment exposure
interferenceRelations.after: RUN.LONG or a quality KEY run
interferenceRelations.authority: SIS section 5 (DR-112 paragraph, SSCTR OB-2 Q1/Q2): heavier, eccentric or new leg work stays away from the day before the long run and the same day before it when days allow; otherwise demand falls by content and the trade-off is explained.

composition.interferenceNotes: Upper-body and trunk work carry no lower-body demand class and create no run-axis cost (R6-HYBRID-ARRANGEMENT claim). Severities are ordinal only, never summed; individual evidence may raise a cause's severity for that athlete (association, not causation).

protect: the week's single quality KEY run
protectedStimuli.strengthRole: Support or maintain: keeps an essential stimulus (main lifts at the goal or phase dose); never removed in event phases.

protectedStimuli.runRole: Easy participation kept on the chosen run days; in strength-led blocks the long run's content may yield (SIS section 5).

protectedStimuli.rule: Pareto first, then lowest worst-case joint harm; a genuine equal-harm opposing trade-off is asked once ('which session should stay freshest this block?').

placementRules.rule: Chosen days and shifts are hard constraints; no session on an unchosen day; more days spread the weekly load, never add to it; missed work is never stacked.

Same day in both sports: two sessions. Same day and same shift: back-to-back, confirmed explicitly; the day's key session goes first by the phase lead; JOINT with both key: ASK; the person can swap. Different shifts on the same day: gap from policy:operational.hybrid.turnHours, labelled 'earlier the same day'.
At most one quality session per week; not on the day before or after the long run when another chosen run day can hold it.

Heavier (HEAVY), HIGH-eccentric or new lower-body work is placed away from the day before the long run and the same day before it when the chosen days allow; when every strength day neighbours the long run, the lower-body demand of that session falls by content (established, non-HIGH-eccentric configurations of the same patterns) and the trade-off is disclosed; in a strength-led block the long run's content may yield instead.

Two heavy lower-body sessions within policy:operational.hybrid.heavyLowerRepeatGapHours are avoided when an alternative exists; axial-HIGH configurations are the first to be replaced by a lower-axial same-pattern alternative when a heavy lower session neighbours a key run or another heavy lower session (axial is a tie-break, never an additive score).
No lower-body strength within policy:operational.hybrid.preRaceStrengthGapHours before the race; race-window strength per policy:operational.event.proximitySemantics.

Consolidation (recovery) week every policy:operational.run.consolidationEveryNthDevelopmentWeek development weeks: run intensity held, long run shortened by policy:operational.run.consolidationLongRunReductionSteps steps, strength sets reduced by policy:operational.strength.consolidationSetReduction; EARNED does not skip it into progression (policy:operational.learning.pooling.consolidationFeedsEarned).

Return states compose with the same relations: return runs are EASY class, no quality in return; every strength exposure of a return-entry week is at the entry dose (policy:operational.return.strengthEntryWeek).

Novice constraints: walk/jog at most policy:operational.establishment.maxWalkJogDaysPerWeek exposures; strength class NONE at most two full templates per week until the first block boundary (strength.noviceDensity).

ranking.horizons: H0 session, H1 week, H2 block (shifted by the phase lead and maintain roles), H3 goal/event (shifted by development and event proximity) (src/r6-balanced.mjs horizonCosts).

infeasibleOrIncomparable.representation: ASK once with the options; a stated temporary preference or strong repeated athlete evidence resolves it.
Non-blocking negotiation; extra days carry walks that convert at block starts.
Non-blocking negotiation when fewer than two patterns fit a session.
Disclosure; material-to-goal feasibility negotiation is R7-B (JUDGE-CQ-R6-05).
Negotiated or asked; never compressed silently.

classification.runClassSource: runtime:src/r6-program.mjs assessCapability at the freeze (reviewed runtime binding of R6-COLD-START). The 45 and 60 minute and 2-day thresholds are runtime constants, not policy fields: declare them at the next policy revision (gap B0-F05).

strengthClasses.predicate: Strength goal NONE or no chosen strength days

skillAdmissibility.rule: Experience NONE/NOVICE: LOW skill; INTERMEDIATE/EXPERIENCED: up to MODERATE; HIGH only when the configuration is familiar (R6 candidatesFor), or reached through strength.skillLadders at a block boundary with agency (B0-C07). Equipment availability never implies competence.

graduation.run: After walk/jog exit, strides become eligible under strides.requiresEstablishedEasyWeeks executed established easy weeks. At a block boundary in a build/development phase, a WALK_JOG-, RESTART- or EASY_LOW-started athlete is re-assessed from executed evidence only: when the last policy:operational.run.qualityRequiresEstablishedEasyWeeks executed weeks each reached at least 60 executed running minutes on at least 2 run days (walks excluded) without an adverse signal, the athlete is treated as EASY_CURRENT for quality eligibility (threshold ladder step 0). Executed evidence supersedes a self-declared NOVICE label for this purpose only. Never inside SPECIFIC/TAPER/race window/post-event, never in RESTART/RETURN mode. All RUN.THRESHOLD quality gates apply.
graduation.strength: B0-C07 skill ladders: PRACTICE -> establishment -> goal dose per pattern; higher-skill configurations only at a block boundary with agency.

archetypes.basis: Derived from the R6 contextual goal model (src/r6-program.mjs buildGoalModel at the freeze; R6 request section 4); no static priority flag.
consumers: Strength goal dose role (development vs support/maintain)
archetypes.derivation: runDev = run goal RACE or PERFORMANCE; strDev = strength goal STRENGTH or HYPERTROPHY. base = STRENGTH if run not programmed; RUN if strength not programmed; with an event: JOINT if strDev else RUN; else JOINT if runDev and strDev; RUN if runDev; STRENGTH if strDev; else JOINT.

items.when: Both programmed and base JOINT (both develop, or neither)

phaseLeads.NEXT_BLOCK: RUN if strength not programmed; STRENGTH if strDev or run not programmed; else JOINT

overlaysNotArchetypes.EVENT_PREP: Phase sequence on any archetype with a supported event (trajectories.event).
overlaysNotArchetypes.NOVICE: Run mode and strength class states (trajectories.novice).

archetypes.temporaryPreference: A stated priority (ON-06 or temporary) resolves genuine trade-offs and same-shift order only; it never sets the archetype.

trajectories.note: State machines; guards reference policy paths; states are PROGRESSION_STATE values written only by executed evidence (R7-A state model).

Nothing progresses from elapsed calendar time

Population and dose evidence from football; no envelope.
laterGate.fallback: lateral-lunge; adductor secondary work in squats and split squats.
